summary: Wabash National Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a convertible senior notes offering due 2032, raising up to $150 million via a Rule 144A private placement. The filing also includes preliminary unaudited financial results for Q2 2026. The Fifth Amendment to the credit agreement permits this additional indebtedness. No specific price, premium, or conversion terms are disclosed. The board's recommendation is not mentioned. The mechanics involve a private placement of convertible notes; the proceeds may be used for capital returns or general purposes. Watch for the final pricing, conversion premium, and any share repurchase or debt repayment plans.
